##Attach and Draw Back Joseki This move is a vital point to secure the corner territory and prevent White from cutting Black apart with an atari at the same point. When Black draws back to here, the cutting point at A becomes the focus of attack and defense. (Vol. 1.) is the often best reinforcement (Vol. 1) and, according to Toshiro Kageyama, is "the only move White need consider"(Lessons in the Fundamentals of Go, p. 41).
is another type of connection. (Vol. 1.)
is a special tactic for moving into the center.
